description: List the most-viewed articles on a Wikimedia project for a single day, or for a full month with day="all-days". Returns each article title, view count, and rank. Filter by access method (desktop, mobile-web, mobile-app, or all-access). Data: Wikimedia Analytics REST API (wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1), no auth required.

day.description: 2-digit day (e.g. 01), or "all-days" for the monthly top list

project.description: Wikimedia project domain (e.g. en.wikipedia, de.wikipedia, commons.wikimedia)

name: wikimedia-analytics.pageviews.top

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Wikipedia Top Viewed Articles
